tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs, tab bar, keypad keys.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Toggle group track, chips, progress track, day cells with nothing scheduled.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on canvas, surface and subtle.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (brand, dates, captions), on canvas, surface and subtle.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Not enough contrast for control edges: use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, unchecked checkboxes and empty PIN dots: 3:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: brand-pink
tokens.usage: The logo pink. Logo, cover and large decorative shapes only; never body text or small icons (3.9:1 on white). Use accent for UI.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pink. Primary buttons, active tab, checked controls, links. Text on canvas, surface, subtle and accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (the dark theme lightens accent, so on-accent turns dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected option background, icon discs, "done" days in the calendar.

tokens.name: skin
tokens.usage: Skin area: tag text, skin streak, skin icons. Text on skin-soft and surface.

tokens.name: skin-soft
tokens.usage: Skin area fills: tag, product thumb, skin streak card.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hair area: tag text, hair streak, hair task due pill. Text on hair-soft and surface.

tokens.name: hair-soft
tokens.usage: Hair area fills: tag, product thumb, hair streak card, due days.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status OK text and dot, on ok-soft. Always paired with the word "OK".

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Status OK badge fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Expiring soon and ingredient conflict text and icon, on warning-soft and surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Expiring soon badge, conflict pills and callouts, partly-done calendar days.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Expired status, Reset app, destructive text. On danger-soft and surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Expired badge fill, missed calendar days, Danger button fill.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Not-opened status text and dot, on neutral-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Not-opened badge fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset; 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Product names, step names, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, chips, field labels, toggle group items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under names, helper text. Never smaller than 13px.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Short group labels inside a card (sentence case, never uppercase). Prefer a Card title or section heading.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, text stacks, small icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row gaps inside cards, list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Onboarding and lock screen gutter and section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations, keypad rows on tall phones.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Product thumbs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, callouts, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and streak tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, toggles, checkboxes, keypad keys, PIN dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, select menus.
